tool_calls: git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff

python -m unittest discover -v && python - <<'PY'
from src.labels import format_labels
cases = [
    ([], False),
    ([" ", "\t", "Alpha"], False),
    ([" beta ", "Alpha", "charlie"], True),
    (["Zoo", "apple", "BANANA"], True),
]
for labels, sort in cases:
    print(labels, sort, '=>', repr(format_labels(labels, sort=sort)))
PY
if command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then pytest -q; else echo 'pytest not installed'; fi
git diff --unified=80 -- src/labels.py tests/test_labels.py && git diff --check
